📺 Prize for Nikolai: the winner's share — alien rations for the pantry. The village eats tonight.
📺 The System presses something humming into Nikolai's hands: Nanite swarm. A cloud of tiny machines. They want to help. They insist.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Pamela Bauer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
Pamela is gone — dead. The errand dies with them; nobody's waiting on those dandelions now.
🕯️ Pamela Bauer is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Pamela kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.

📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
"OH! OH! PRECISE MEND! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Pamela Bauer, 62 days. The mantle passes to Rachel Adeyemi.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Rachel Adeyemi, 62 — a bartender. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Scream Cheese, Echo Location.
The village's quarrel was with Pamela — and Pamela is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Nikolai speaks for Rachel — "Pamela trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Rachel before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
